en.question: When Normal Summoning a "Red-Eyes" monster after using the second effect of <<11929>>, can the additional Normal Summon be negated by <<4861>>?
en.title: When Normal Summoning a "Red-Eyes" monster after using the second effect of <<11929>>, can the additional Normal Summon be negated by <<4861>>?
